# RESA Corporation

> > A comprehensive platform for statistical analysis, econometrics, and forecasting with free online calculators and educational resources.

RESA Corporation provides interactive tools and tutorials for descriptive statistics, regression analysis, and data visualization. The site offers both theoretical foundations through statistical formulae and practical applications via free online software, serving students, researchers, and professionals in quantitative analysis.

## Key Topics

- Descriptive Statistics
- Statistical Analysis
- Econometrics
- Forecasting
- Central Tendency
- Correlation Analysis
- Linear Regression
- Data Visualization
- Hypothesis Testing
- Time Series Analysis
- Statistical Distributions
- Quartiles
- Kurtosis
- Free Statistics Calculator
- Xycoon Platform

## Descriptive Statistics Tutorials

- [Descriptive Statistics](https://resacorp.com/descriptivestatistics.htm): Guide to descriptive statistics covering formulas and data analysis methods
- [Central Tendency (Means, Averages)](https://resacorp.com/central_tendency.htm): Tutorial on central tendency measures with free calculator tool
- [Concentration (Entropy, Herfindahl, Gini Coefficient)](https://resacorp.com/concentration.htm): Guide to concentration statistics including Gini and Herfindahl indices
- [Quartiles](https://resacorp.com/quartiles.htm): Tutorial on quartile calculations with ungrouped data examples
- [Moments](https://resacorp.com/moments.htm): Example of centered and uncentered moments in statistical analysis
- [Skewness and Peakedness (Kurtosis)](https://resacorp.com/skewnespeakedness.htm): Tutorial on skewness and kurtosis coefficient calculations

## Data Visualization & Analysis

- [Histogram](https://resacorp.com/histogram.htm): Guide to histograms and goodness-of-fit testing with data visualization
- [Box Plot (Box-and-Whisker Plot)](https://resacorp.com/box_plot.htm): Tutorial on box plots and whisker plots with statistical examples
- [Density Trace](https://resacorp.com/density_trace.htm): Examples of kernel density estimation and data visualization techniques

## Correlation & Regression

- [Pearson Product Moment Correlation](https://resacorp.com/correlation.htm): Tutorial on Pearson correlation with practical statistical examples
- [Partial Correlation](https://resacorp.com/partial_correlation.htm): Guide to partial correlation analysis with regression examples
- [Simple Linear Regression](https://resacorp.com/simple_linear_regression.htm): Tutorial on simple linear regression with statistical analysis examples

## Reference & Tools

- [Statistical Formulae](https://resacorp.com/formulae.htm): Reference resource with statistical formulas and mathematical definitions
- [Free Online Software](https://resacorp.com/free_online_software.htm): Directory of free online software and application service providers
- [Resources](https://resacorp.com/resources.htm): Collection of scientific resources for statistics and econometrics

## Navigation & Support

- [Homepage](https://resacorp.com/index.htm): Homepage covering statistics, econometrics, forecasting and online applications
- [Site Map](https://resacorp.com/toc.htm): Site map and table of contents for website navigation
